function.description: Calculates the applicable tax for a given income amount. It applies different tax rates based on specified income brackets. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

income.description: The total income for which the tax needs to be calculated, in dollars. This is a float type value.

filing_status.description: The filing status of the taxpayer, which affects the tax brackets.

tax_year.description: The tax year for which the calculation is being done. The year format should be YYYY, such as 2022.

deductions.description: The total amount of deductions claimed, in dollars. This is a float type value.

credits.description: The total amount of tax credits claimed to reduce the amount of tax owed, in dollars. This is a float type value.
